title: Dashboard Hotlist + quick todo
content:
Purpose: rolling hotlist for console observability items I expect to touch today/evening. Lightweight, action-focused — not a full runbook.

High-level context:
- Two customer reports this morning about slow dashboard loads and stale alert counts (regions: us-west1 + eu-west2).
- Backend metrics show a 30% increase in tail latency for dashboard-api calls at p95 over the last 3 deploys. No clear spike in error rate.
- Priority: reduce customer impact and gather repro data; avoid heavy refactors during outage window.

HOTLIST (priority order)
1) Dashboard load slow / blank panels (customer-facing) — owner: Izumi
   - Symptom: panels load, then show spinner for ~15s, some panels never finish.
   - Impact: high for customers with >10 dashboards (slow UX). Seen since 06:12 UTC.
   - Quick repro (local / prod): curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://console.redwood.ai/api/dashboard/summary?dashboard_id=abc123&range=1h'
   - Quick checks: see dashboard-api logs for downstream timeout to metrics-store (look for "kv_fetch_timeout").
   - Temporary mitigation: increase downstream timeout to 12s for dashboard-api in prod canary (route flag) — low risk.
   - Next steps: open SRE-987 (exists), attach sample request/response, add timeline. Notify CS when mitigation applied.

2) Stale alert counts on Overview page — owner: Rory (backup: Izumi)
   - Observed: alert counter displayed "0" for a set of customers while Prometheus shows firing alerts.
   - Suspect: caching layer (edge-cache) TTL set incorrectly on /alerts/summary endpoint.
   - Quick test: hit endpoint with cache-buster param & check X-Cache headers.
   - Quick fix: purge route-level cache for /alerts/* on edge for affected customers. Document purge IDs in SRE ticket.

3) High p95 for dashboard-api (investigation) — owner: Maya
   - Metrics: p95 latency up 30% last 6 hours; p50 stable. Suggests tail issue (GC? cold caches?).
   - Action items: gather flamegraphs for the 06:00–07:00 window, sample heap profiles for one instance; run perf on candidate hosts.

Notes-to-self (commands / snippets)
- k get pods -n console | grep dashboard-api
- kubectl logs -n console $(kubectl get pods -n console -l app=dashboard-api -o name | head -n 1) --since=2h | rg "kv_fetch_timeout|timeout" -n
- curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PROD_TOKEN' "https://console.redwood.ai/api/dashboard/summary?dashboard_id=abc123&range=1h&cache_buster=$(date +%s)" -i
- curl -I https://edge-1.redwood.ai/alerts/summary?customer=acct-991  (check X-Cache, X-Edge-Served)
- tracelog: trace-id from customer report = 01-4d2a... attach to JIRA and slack thread.

Customer comms (short)
- To: CS (thread) — "We’re actively investigating dashboard slowness and stale alert counts. I’ll apply a low-risk mitigation (edge cache purge / extend backend timeout) and post updates in 30m."
- When to escalate to SEs: if mitigation fails or p95 stays >2x baseline after 45m.

Follow-ups / longer-term tickets to create (if hotlist repros true)
- ENG-1423: Reduce dashboard-api tail latency by addressing blocking KV fetch; propose async fetch or parallelization. (Owner: backend eng)
- ENG-1424: Edge-cache TTL review & finer-grained invalidation policy (Owner: infra)
- ENG-1425: Add synthetic checks for panels to catch silent failures in pipeline (Owner: observability)

Random notes / heuristics (for later)
- If p50 OK but p95 only, look at per-request fanout (many panels -> many remote calls), consider batching keys.
- Watch for long-running GC pauses on Python workers — collect pprof.
- Keep mitigation short-lived; follow with canary rollback if needed.

End-of-shift checklist
- Post update to #console-prod (timeline + mitigation applied + ticket links).
- Mark SRE ticket with final notes and transfer to eng if code change needed.
- Save flamegraphs/profiles to /tmp/obs-hotlist-<date>.tar.gz and link in JIRA.

Scratch TODO (me)
- [ ] Apply edge cache purge for affected accounts (target: 06:45–06:50 UTC)
- [ ] Roll canary timeout increase if logs show downstream timeouts (target: 07:10 UTC)
- [ ] Collect one yubikey-signed copy of trace logs and attach to SRE-987
- [ ] Ping CS and add short FAQ for customers asking about "empty panels"

Timestamped logs / micro-notes (append-only):
- 2026-03-11 06:20 UTC — received first customer report from acct-991 via CS (attached trace id).
- 2026-03-11 06:28 UTC — verified dashboard-api tail latency spike in prod metrics.
- 2026-03-11 06:35 UTC — purged cache for acct-991 on edge-2; partial improvement observed.

Bottom line: short, low-risk mitigations first (cache purge, timeout tweak), collect evidence for root cause, escalate to ENG for design fix if repros stable.

— Izumi
